answer: Proposal: pay capital, not headcount. Each epoch the ledger snapshots stake locked the full epoch (withdrawals delayed one epoch) and pays key i (R*s_i)/T, T = total locked. No headcount term exists, so the summit a key reaches is s_i/T: splitting S over n clones still pays n*R*(S/n)/T = R*S/T, the one-key reward; a clone spiral buys no extra share, only tx fees. Flash loans find no harbor: locks outlive the loan, and a balance can't lock twice. Limit: this neutralizes splitting, not plutocracy; a whale needs no clones, and any per-key perk would revive sybil profit.
